drops.name: Devcon Southeast Asia 2024
drops.description:
Devcon is the Ethereum conference for developers, thinkers, and makers.

Devcon's mission is to bring decentralized protocols, tools, and culture to the people and make Ethereum more accessible around the world.

Devcon is a four-day event, all in one big venue. You'll meet everyone in that one place. Devcon Week will span the entire week of November 9-17, with events before and after Devcon, organized by the local and global Ethereum community.

drops.description: Connect with other builders, talk to teams looking for talent, meet your users, or showcase your app at the Ethereum World’s Fair. Explore what Ethereum is for and what it enables, test applications, and win in some fun challenges.

drops.name: The DeFi Mullet
drops.description:
Fintech in the front, DeFi in the back. 

2025 marks the genesis year of DeFi Mullet in action, with Coinbase, Crypto.com, Gemini, Ledger, Trust Wallet, Safe Wallet, and many more fintech, exchange, and DeFi Apps integrating Morpho as the universal lending network. 

This is only the beginning. Long live the DeFi Mullet.

Now your money flows as freely as you do. Your Offramp account adapts to your lifestyle so you can receive globally and spend without borders.

Spend your crypto and global earnings effortlessly in the real-world. 

Instant, global, and without banks in the middle.

R3AL Blocks empowers Latin American innovation by tokenizing real-world assets to expand financial access across LATAM through simple, secure, and onchain solutions.
